description: Hermes Agent through the vendor's PowerShell installer, installed and never launched, found by the launcher it writes under %LOCALAPPDATA%.
why: The idle twin of 107. Nothing is launched, so the launcher on disk is the only witness: filesystem-windows.sql's %LOCALAPPDATA%\<app>\bin\*.exe branch reads it, and require_rows holds the file row to its path. setup prints the hermes process rows, which must be none. `forbid` matches 107's.
known_gaps: Only a launcher one level under %LOCALAPPDATA% is read: an installer that keeps its commands deeper, or outside bin\, is still invisible while idle.
